# CPDataKit v0.12.0

The local workbench is simplified around one task at a time. A project page is now one column with
a single sans-serif type scale. Project switching and output recovery sit in the top bar; parsing
options, settings reuse, the raw preview, job history and advanced tools open on demand.

CSV field declarations appear as readable summaries of source column, output field, unit and
type/role. Editing expands only the selected row; cancelling keeps the previous values. Import
remains blocked while a row is open, a declaration or source description is missing, no column is
kept, or a column-located server error is unresolved. Changing a field, kept column or source
description clears the previous confirmation. Pending items and errors stay visible.

CSV preview now returns `sample_rows`, up to five aligned records with their physical line numbers
and unconverted cell text. The raw preview is built only from these records, never by stitching
per-column samples. Reusable settings exclude them.

Data, validation, conversion, report, download, settings-reuse and recovery contracts are unchanged.
Unit compatibility is still decided by the server at import; the workbench does not infer
dimensionless units or engineering/true stress-strain definitions.

Python remains >=3.12. Runtime dependencies, data formats and release workflows are unchanged.
See the [workbench guide](https://github.com/koocmitwho/cpdatakit/blob/v0.12.0/docs/workbench-guide.md)
and [verification record](https://github.com/koocmitwho/cpdatakit/blob/v0.12.0/docs/verification/2026-10-10-v0120.md).
